40004194.author: पदार्थः
40004194.content: शर्वर्याम् after the night passed, प्रभातायां तु at dawn, पृथुवक्षाः broadchested, महायशाः of great fame, रामः Rama, शुभलक्षणम् of auspicious signs (on his body), सौमित्रिम्  Sumitra's son, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, उवाच said.

40004194.author: Translation
40004194.content: As the night advanced towards dawn, broadchested Rama of great renown said to Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, who had auspicious marks on his body:

40004195.author: पदार्थः
40004195.content: तात dear Lakshmana, अयम् now it is, भास्करोदयकालः time for sunrise, भगवती venerable, निशा night, गता is over, सुकृष्ण: deep dark, विहगः bird, असौ कोकिलः cuckoo, कूजति is singing.

40004195.author: Translation
40004195.content: O dear Lakshmana the holy night is over and it is time for sunrise. The deep dark bird, the cuckoo is singing.

40004196.author: पदार्थः
40004196.content: वने forest, नदताम् screaming, बर्हिणानाम् of the peacocks, निर्घोषः sound, श्रूयते heard, सौम्य handsome, शीघ्रगाम् flowing rapidly, सागरङ्गमाम् to merge in the sea, जाह्नवीम् to Ganga, तराम need to cross.

40004196.author: Translation
40004196.content: Listen to the screams of the peacocks in the forest. The Ganga is flowing fast to merge in the sea. We need to cross it.

40004197.author: पदार्थः
40004197.content: मित्रनन्दनः one who keeps his friends happy, सः सौमित्रि: that Lakshmana the son of Sumitra, रामस्य Rama's, वचः words, विज्ञाय knowing, गुहम् to Guha, सूतं च to the charioteer also, आमन्त्र्य calling, भ्रातुः brother's, अग्रतः in front, अतिष्ठत् stood.

40004197.author: Translation
40004197.content: In response to Rama's desire, Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, one who brings joy to his friends, called Guha and the charioteer (Sumantra) and stood before his brother.

40004198.author: पदार्थः
40004198.content: सः स्थपतिः that king (of the nisadas), रामस्य Rama's, वचनम् words, निशम्य having heard, प्रतिगृह्य च accepting (the proposal), तूर्णम् quickly, सचिवान् ministers, आहूय calling, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40004198.author: Translation
40004198.content: Having heard and accepted Rama's proposal, the king of the nisadas called his ministers at once and said:

40004199.author: पदार्थः
40004199.content: वाहनसंयुक्ताम् along with the boat, कर्णग्राहवतीम् with  helmsmen, शुभाम् auspicious, सुप्रताराम् with a rowing rod, दृढाम् strong, नावम् boat, शीघ्रम् swiftly, अस्य with one who can row the boat, तीर्थे to the sacred bank (of Ganga), उपाहर fetch.

40004199.author: Translation
40004199.content: Get quickly to the sacred bank (of  Ganga) a strong, auspicious boat equipped with rowing rods and helmsmen who can help cross the river with ease

40004200.author: पदार्थः
40004200.content: महान् great, गुहामात्यगणः ministers of Guha, तम् his, समादेशम् order, निशम्य having heard, रुचिराम् beautiful, नावम् boat, उपोह्य having brought, गुहाय to Guha, प्रत्यवेदयत् informed.

40004200.author: Translation
40004200.content: The ministers heard the orders, soon brought  a beautiful boat and informed Guha (that his orders have been carried out).

40004201.author: पदार्थः
40004201.content: ततः then, सः गुहः that Guha, प्राञ्जलि: भूत्वा with folded hands, राघवम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् said, देवः O king, इयम् this, नौः boat, उपस्थिता is kept here, ते for you, भूयः agian, किम् what, करवाणि I will do?

40004201.author: Translation
40004201.content: Then Guha with folded palms said to Rama: O king, the boat ready. Tell me what else can I do for you.

40004202.author: पदार्थः
40004202.content: पुरुषव्याघ्र tiger among men, अमरसुतप्रख्य reputed like a god's son, सागरगाम् flowing to the sea, नदीम् river, तर्तुम् to cross, तव your, इयम् this, नौः boat, सुव्रत engaged in vows, त्वम् you, ताम् that,  आरोह climb up.

40004202.author: Translation
40004202.content: O best among men, renowned like a god's son and constantly engaged in vows, here is the boat for you to cross the Ganga flowing into the sea. Do board it.

40004203.author: पदार्थः
40004203.content: अथ thereafter, महातेजाः luminous, रामः Rama, गुहम्, to Guha इदम् these, वचः words, उवाच said, भवता through you, कृतकामः accomplished the work, अस्मि am, शीघ्रम् quickly, आरोप्यताम् getting on to the boat.

40004203.author: Translation
40004203.content: Thereafter the radiant Rama said to Guha, You have fulfilled my desire. Keep all our belongings in the boat.

40004204.author: पदार्थः
40004204.content: ततः then, तौ राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, सीतया सह with Sita, कलापान् quivers, सन्नह्य having tied, खड्गौ च swords, बध्वा wearing, धन्विनौ holding the bows, येन गङ्गाम् towards Ganga, जग्मतुः went on.

40004204.author: Translation
40004204.content: Rama and Lakshmana then put on their quivers, fastened their swords and holding their bows went towards Ganga along with Sita.

40004205.author: पदार्थः
40004205.content: सूतः charioteer, प्राञ्जलि: with folded hands, विनीतवत् humbly, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, राममेव तु near Rama, उपगम्य going towards, अहम् I, किम् what, करवाणि do you want me to do , इति this, अब्रवीत् asked.

40004205.author: Translation
40004205.content: The charioteer (Sumantra) approached the righteous Rama and asked him with folded hands: What can I do?

40004206.author: पदार्थः
40004206.content: ततः then, दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha (Rama), सुमन्त्रम्  to Sumantra, उत्तमदक्षिणेन with his right hand, करेण  स्पृशन् touching, अब्रवीत् said, सुमन्त्र Sumantra, पुनरेव again, शीघ्रम् immediately, याहि proceed, राज्ञः सकाशे to the king, अप्रमत्तः च inattentive in looking after, भव be.

40004206.author: Translation
40004206.content: Rama then caressed  Sumantra with his right hand and said, Sumantra, go back immediately and never be inattentive in serving the king.

40004207.author: पदार्थः
40004207.content: मम myself, एतावत् till here, कृतं हि brought, निवर्तस्व return, रथम् chariot, विहाय leaving, पद्भ्याम् on foot, महावनम् the great forest, गमिष्यामि wiill go, इति this, उवाच said.

40004207.author: Translation
40004207.content: You have done enough. I shall now leave the chariot and walk into the great forest.

40004208.author: पदार्थः
40004208.content: सारथिः charioteer, सः सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, आत्मानम् self, अभ्यनुज्ञातम् permitted to go, अवेक्षय having seen, आर्तः pained, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् (best) among men, इक्ष्वाकम् of the Ikshvakus, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.

40004208.author: Translation
40004208.content: Having been permitted to go, Sumantra, the distressed charioteer, said to Rama, the best among men, and a descendant of the Ikshvaku race:

40004209.author: पदार्थः
40004209.content: सभ्रातृभार्यस्य of one with brother and wife, तव your, प्राकृतवत् like a common man, वने in the forest, वासः residing, इदम् this, इह लोके in this world, केनचित् पुरुषेण by any person, नातिक्रान्तम् not overcome.

40004209.author: Translation
40004209.content: None else in this world would be able to live in the forest as you have resolved to, like a common man, along with your brother and spouse.

40004210.author: पदार्थः
40004210.content: त्वाम् to you, व्यसनम् grief, आगतं चेत् has come, ब्रह्मचर्ये celibacy, स्वधीते वा learning the Vedas, मार्दवार्जवयोर्वापि compassionate and pure, फलोदयः this is the result, नास्ति no use, मन्ये I think so.

40004210.author: Translation
40004210.content: If your celibacy and your grief are the consequences of your study of the Vedic lore, your compassionate nature and simplicity of character, I think there is no use of all these (virtues).

40004211.author: पदार्थः
40004211.content: वीर valiant, राघव scion of the Raghu race (Rama), त्वम् you, वैदेह्या सह with Vaidehi, भ्रात्रा चैव and brother, वने forest, वसन् residing, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, जयन्निव as if winning, गतिम् good status, प्राप्स्यसे will acquire.

40004211.author: Translation
40004211.content: Valiant scion of the Raghus dwelling in the forest along with Vaidehi (Sita) and brother Lakshmana you will attain the status as if you have won the three worlds.

40004212.author: पदार्थः
40004212.content: राम Rama, वयम् we, हताः खलु are destroyed, ये by, त्वयापि you also, उपवञ्चिताः deprived of, दुःखभागिनः full of sorrow, पापायाः sinful, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi, वशम् under the control, एष्यामः caught up like that.

40004212.author: Translation
40004212.content: Deprived of you, O Rama we will come under the control of that sinful Kaikeyi. We will suffer and die.

40004213.author: पदार्थः
40004213.content: तदा then, सारथिः charioteer, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, इति thus, ब्रुवन् saying, दूरगतम् gone afar, आत्मसमम् like his own self, रामम् Rama, दृष्ट्वा seeing, दुःखार्तः agonised, चिरम् long time, रुरुदे cried.

40004213.author: Translation
40004213.content: Rama was like his (Sumantra's) own self. When Sumantra, the charioteer, saw that  Rama was preparing to go afar for a long time, he started weeping aloud in deep distress.

40004214.author: पदार्थः
40004214.content: ततः then, बाष्पे tears, विगते shedding, स्पृष्टोदकम् taking a sip of water, शुचिम् pure, तं सूतम् to that charioteer, रामस्तु Rama, पुनः पुनः again and again, मधुरम् sweet, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.

40004214.author: Translation
40004214.content: After the flow of tears ceased Sumantra took a sip of water and became sanctified. Then Rama addressed him with sweet words over and over again:

40004215.author: पदार्थः
40004215.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvaku family, त्वया you, तुल्यम् like, सुहृदम् friend, नोपलक्षये do not see, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, माम् me, यथा as, न शोचेत् not think, तथा like that, कुरु you do.

40004215.author: Translation
40004215.content: I find none else like you as friendly as you are to the Ikshvaku race. So do whatever you like  to see that king Dasaratha does not brood over me.

40004216.author: पदार्थः
40004216.content: जगतीपतिः lord of the world (Dasaratha), शोकोपहतचेताश्च consciousness overwhelmed with grief, वृद्धश्च and old also, कामभावावसन्नश्च full of passion, तस्मात् therefore, ते to you, एतत् all this, ब्रवीमि  I am telling.

40004216.author: Translation
40004216.content: I tell you this because the lord of the earth (Dasaratha), is in deep distress. He is old. And he is under the control of his passion.

40004217.author: पदार्थः
40004217.content: महात्मा great, सः that, महीपतिः king Dasaratha, यद्यत् in that way, किञ्चित् a little, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi, प्रियकामार्थम् to make happy, आज्ञापयेत् orders, तत् that, अविकाङ्क्षया all that, कार्यम् tasks be done.

40004217.author: Translation
40004217.content: To make Kaikeyi  happy, do whatever little the great king Dasaratha orders you to do.

40004218.author: पदार्थः
40004218.content: एषाम् whatever, मनः in the mind, सर्वकृत्येषु to do all those, यत् न प्रतिहन्यते creater no obstacles, एतदर्थम् that is why, नरेश्वराः king, राज्यानि kingdom, प्रशासति हि rule.

40004218.author: Translation
40004218.content: The minds of kings create no hurdles in all that they want to do. That is why they rule kingdoms.

40004219.author: पदार्थः
40004219.content: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, सः महाराजः that great king, यत् those tasks, यथा in whatever manner, अलीकम् sad, नाधिगच्छति not feel, दुःखेन in grief, न च ताम्यति not feel distressed, तत् those tasks, तथा in that way, कुरु do.

40004219.author: Translation
40004219.content: Sumantra do things exactly in the manner the great king desires so that he does not feel sad or disappointed.

40004220.author: पदार्थः
40004220.content: अदृष्टदुःखम् one who has not experienced any sorrow, वृद्धम् old, आर्यम् respectable, जितेन्द्रियम् one who has conquered the senses, राजानम् to king, मम हेतोः on my behalf, अभिवाद्यैव offering respects, इदम् these, वचः words, त्वम् you, ब्रूयाः tell.

40004220.author: Translation
40004220.content: After offering your salutations, tell these words, on my behalf, to the king who is respectable, bent with age and who has conquered his senses and never experienced any sorrow before.

40004221.author: पदार्थः
40004221.content: अयोध्यायाः from Ayodhya, च्युताश्चेति having been removed, वने in the forest, वत्स्यामहेति च have to dwell, अहम् we, नैव अनुशोचामि do not regret, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, मैथिली च and Sita also, न not.

40004221.author: Translation
40004221.content: I do not regret my banishment from Ayodhya to live in the forest. Neither Lakshmana nor Sita does.

40004222.author: पदार्थः
40004222.content: चतुर्दशसु fourteen, वर्षेषु years, निवृत्तेषु on completion, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आगतान् coming, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, मां च I also, सीतां च and Sita, पुनः पुनः again and again, द्रक्ष्यसे will keep seeing.

40004222.author: Translation
40004222.content: Very quickly these fourteen years will come to an end and we will return (to Ayodhya). Then you will see me, Lakshmana and Sita off and on.

40004223.author: पदार्थः
40004223.content: राजानम् to the king, एवम् all this, उक्तवा having told, सुमन्त्र Sumantra, मे मातरं च to my mother also, सहिताः with, अन्याः other, देवीश्च queens, कैकेयीं च Kaikeyi, पुनः पुनः again and again, आरोग्यम् wellbeing, ब्रूहि convey, अथ and, सीतायाः Sita's, मम च mine, आर्यस्य लक्ष्मणस्य च Lakshmana's also, पादाभिवन्दनम् prostection at the feet, कौशल्याम् Kausalya.

40004223.author: Translation
40004223.content: Having said this to the king, O Sumantra tell my mother, the other queens including Kaikeyi again and again about my wellbeing and the wellbeing of Lakshmana and Sita. Convey our respectful salutations at the feet of mother Kausalya.

40004224.author: पदार्थः
40004224.content: राजानम् to the king, एवम् all this, उक्तवा having told, सुमन्त्र Sumantra, मे मातरं च to my mother also, सहिताः with, अन्याः other, देवीश्च queens, कैकेयीं च Kaikeyi, पुनः पुनः again and again, आरोग्यम् wellbeing, ब्रूहि convey, अथ and, सीतायाः Sita's, मम च mine, आर्यस्य लक्ष्मणस्य च Lakshmana's also, पादाभिवन्दनम् prostection at the feet, कौशल्याम् Kausalya.

40004224.author: Translation
40004224.content: Having said this to the king, O Sumantra tell my mother, the other queens including Kaikeyi again and again about my wellbeing and the wellbeing of Lakshmana and Sita. Convey our respectful salutations at the feet of mother Kausalya.

40004225.author: पदार्थः
40004225.content: महाराजं to the maharaja, is also, ब्रूयाः tell, भरतम् Bharata, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आनय send for, आगतश्चापि and on arrival, भरतः Bharata, नृपमते according to the king's desire, पदे king's position, स्थाप्यः be given.

40004225.author: Translation
40004225.content: Tell the king to send for Bharata quickly, and on his arrival, he be placed in the position of the king as per his own desire.

40004226.author: पदार्थः
40004226.content: भरतम् Bharata, परिष्वज्य embracing, यौवराज्ये crown prince, अभिषिच्य च having coronated, अस्मत्संतापजम् arising out of our absence, दुःखम् sorrow, त्वाम् you, न अभिभविष्यति will not affect you.

40004226.author: Translation
40004226.content: On embracing Bharata and making him the crownprince the sorrow due to our departure will not affect you.

40004227.author: पदार्थः
40004227.content: भरतश्चापि Bharata also, वक्तव्यः should be told, राजनि at the king, यथा just as, वर्तसे treats, सर्वास्वेव at all, मातृषु mothers, तथा likewise, अविशेषतः without differentiating, वर्तेथाः behave.

40004227.author: Translation
40004227.content: You should tell Bharata that just as he treats the king so should he treat all the mothers without differentiating betwen them.

40004228.author: पदार्थः
40004228.content: तव your, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, यथा च just as, सुमित्रा च Sumitra also, विशेषतः in a special manner, देवी Devi, sumitra विशेषतः specially, मम माता my mother, कौशल्या Kausalya, तथैव in the same way.

40004228.author: Translation
40004228.content: Just as you treat Kaikeyi and Sumitra in a special manner, so should you treat Devi Kausalya, my mother.

40004229.author: पदार्थः
40004229.content: तातस्य father's, प्रियकामेन loving desire, यौवराज्यम् princeregency, अपेक्षता waits, त्वया your, उभयोः both, लोकयोः worlds, यत् also, सुखम् happiness, एधितुम् to attain, शक्यम् able.

40004229.author: Translation
40004229.content: Princeregency is awaiting you because of our father's loving desire. See that through you (your actions) he is able to attain happiness in both the worlds.

40004230.author: पदार्थः
40004230.content: रामेण by Rama, निवर्त्यमानः sent back, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, शोककर्शितः afflicted with grief, तत् then, सर्वम् all, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, स्नेहात् out of affection, काकुत्स्थम् Rama of Kakutstha race, अब्रवीत् said.

40004230.author: Translation
40004230.content: When Sumantra was asked by Rama to go back, he grew griefstricken. Having heard all that was said by the scion of the Kakutsthas, he replied:

40004231.author: पदार्थः
40004231.content: स्नेहात् out of love, अविक्लबः without fear, नोपचारेण informally, अहम् I am, यत् वाक्यम् these words, ब्रूयाम् telling, तत् then, भक्तिमान् इति like a devotee, त्वम् you, क्षन्तुम् to excuse, अर्हसि तावत् that.

40004231.author: Translation
40004231.content: I beg your pardon for what I have told you out of love. Accept it as the words of a devotee expressed without fear or formality.

40004232.author: पदार्थः
40004232.content: अहम् I, त्वद्विहीनः leaving you, तव your, वियोगेन तावत् being separated from you, पुत्रशोकाकुलामिव like one who has lost her son, ताम् that, पुरीम् to the city (of Ayodhya), कथं हि how can I, प्रतियास्यामि return.

40004232.author: Translation
40004232.content: Without you how can I go back to the city (of Ayodhya) which, separated from you, is grieving like a lady who has lost her son?

40004233.author: पदार्थः
40004233.content: तदा then, जनः people, सराममपि with Rama, मे रथम् my chariot, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तावत् then, विना रामम् without Rama, रथम् chariot, दृष्ट्वा seeing, सा पुरी (people of) that city, विदीर्येतापि will be brokenhearted.

40004233.author: Translation
40004233.content: The people who had seen Rama board the chariot will be brokenhearted to see it without him.

40004234.author: पदार्थः
40004234.content: शून्यम् empty, इमम् this, रथम् chariot, दृष्ट्वा seeing, आहवे हतवीरम् the hero killed in war, सूतावशेषम् with only the charioteer left, स्वम् they, सैन्यम् इव like the army, नगरी entering the city, दैन्यम् pitiable, गच्छेत् हि as will become.

40004234.author: Translation
40004234.content: Seeing the empty chariot the people of the city will look pitiable just like an army left only with the charioteer after its hero is killed in the war.

40004235.author: पदार्थः
40004235.content: प्रजाः people, अद्य today, दूरे at a distance, निवसन्तम् अपि although living, मानसेन in their minds, अग्रतः in front, स्थितम् staying, त्वाम् you, चिन्तयन्त्यः thinking, निराहाराः without food, कृताः done, नूनम् certainly.

40004235.author: Translation
40004235.content: Although living at a distance, the subjects feel in their minds that you are just ahead of them. Today they will certainly go without food, brooding over you.

40004236.author: पदार्थः
40004236.content: राम Rama, त्वत्प्रवासने by your departure, त्वच्छोकक्लान्तचेतसां their minds exhausted with sorrow,  प्रजानाम् people, वृत्तम् that which has happened, यादृशम् all their sorrow, सङ्कुलम् full of agony, तत् then, त्वया you, दृष्टं हि have seen.

40004236.author: Translation
40004236.content: At the time of your departure, O Rama, you have seen all that happened, the hearts of the people exhausted with grief.

40004237.author: पदार्थः
40004237.content: त्वद्विप्रवासने at the time of your banishment, पौरैः by citizens, यः how much of, आर्तनादः cry of agony, मुक्तः released (raised), सरथम् with chariot, माम् me, निशाम्यैव on seeing, ततः then, शतगुणम् a hundredfold, कुर्युः will make.

40004237.author: Translation
40004237.content: You have witnessed the cry of agony raised by the citizens at the time of your banishment. Now when they see the (empty) chariot, they will make it (raise their cry) a hundredfold.

40004238.author: पदार्थः
40004238.content: असौ Alas, सुतः son, मया myself, मातुलकुलम् to the maternal uncle's, नीतः took, सन्तापम् grief, मा कृथाः do not make, इति this, अहम् I, देवीम् Kausalya, वक्ष्यामि किं चापि what can I say?

40004238.author: Translation
40004238.content: What shall I say to Kausalya? Shall I say 'O venerable queen I have left your son at his maternal uncle's, hence don't grieve'.

40004239.author: पदार्थः
40004239.content: अहम् I, असत्यम् untrue, ईदृशम् like this, वचनमपि words too, नैव ब्रूयाम् not tell, अहम् I, अप्रियम् unpleasant, सत्यम् truth, इदं वचः such words, कथम् how can, ब्रूयाम् I speak.

40004239.author: Translation
40004239.content: How can I lie to her? How can I tell her the unpleasent truth?

40004240.author: पदार्थः
40004240.content: त्वद्बन्धुजनवाहिनः carrying your king, मम my, नियोगस्था under command, हयोत्तमाः excellent horses, त्वया हीनम् without you, रथम् chariot, कथम् how, प्रवक्ष्यन्ति will draw.

40004240.author: Translation
40004240.content: How can these excellent horses who used to carry you and your friends till now draw this chariot without you even though they are at my command?

40004241.author: पदार्थः
40004241.content: तत् that is why, अनघ O sinless one, त्वदृते without you, अहम् I, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, गन्तुम् to go, न शक्ष्यामि cannot, माम् me, वनवासानुयानाय to accompany you in exile,  अनुज्ञातुम् to give consent, अर्हसि behoves you.

40004241.author: Translation
40004241.content: That is why, O sinless one I cannot go back to Ayodhya without you. Allow me to accompany you into your exile.

40004242.author: पदार्थः
40004242.content: याचमानस्य request, मे my, त्यागमेव forsaking, करिष्यसि यदि if you, त्वया by you, त्यक्तमात्रः immediately after being forsaken, इह here, सरथः with the chariot, अग्निम् into fire प्रवेक्ष्यामि I will enter.

40004242.author: Translation
40004242.content: If you forsake me in spite of my request I shall immediately enter fire along with my chariot.

40004243.author: पदार्थः
40004243.content: राघव O Rama, वने in the forest, यानि all those, ते to you, तपोविघ्नकराणि causing obstacles to your austerity, भविष्यन्ति are expected, तानि सत्त्वानि all those animals, रथेन with my chariot, प्रतिबाधिष्ये will avert by retaliating.

40004243.author: Translation
40004243.content: With my chariot I shall retaliate and prevent all those animals in the forest causing obstacles to your austerities, O Rama

40004244.author: पदार्थः
40004244.content: त्वत्कृतेन by your grace, मया by me, रथचर्याकृतम् by driving the chariot, सुखम् pleasure, अवाप्तम् is experienced, त्वत्कृते न by your favour, अहम् I, वनवासकृतम् dwelling in the forest, सुखम् pleasure, आशंसे I am looking forward.

40004244.author: Translation
40004244.content: By your grace I experienced the pleasure of driving your chariot, and by your grace, too, I am looking forward to deriving the pleasure of dwelling in the forest.

40004245.author: पदार्थः
40004245.content: प्रसीद be pleased, आरण्ये in the forest, ते to you, प्रत्यनन्तरः very close, भवितुम् to become, इच्छामि desirng, मे to me, प्रत्यनन्तरः be favourable (close), भव to me, प्रीत्या affectionately, अभिहितम् to be told,  इच्छामि wish.

40004245.author: Translation
40004245.content: Be pleased. I wish to stay with you in the forest I long to hear from you these favourable words, 'Stay with me'.

40004246.author: पदार्थः
40004246.content: वीर O valiant one, इमे these, हयश्चापि horses also, वनवासिनः dwelling in the forest, ते to you, परिचर्याम् service, करिष्यन्ति if they do, यदि if so, परमाम् supreme, गतिम् state, प्राप्स्यन्ति will attain.

40004246.author: Translation
40004246.content: O valiant one, if these horses too could render services to you while you dwell in the forest, they would attain the supreme state.

40004247.author: पदार्थः
40004247.content: वने in the forest, वसन् while dwelling, मूर्ध्ना with my head, तव your, शुश्रूषणम् service, करिष्यामि will render, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, देवलोकं वा or the world of the gods, अहम् I, सर्वथा altogether, प्रजहामि relinquish.

40004247.author: Translation
40004247.content: As I dwell in the forest, I shall serve you with my head bowed. For this I may altogether relinquish Ayodhya or even heaven.

40004248.author: पदार्थः
40004248.content: त्वया विना without you, मया by me, दुष्कृतकर्मणा by the wicked, महेन्द्रस्य Indra's, राजधानी यथा like the capital, सा अयोध्या that Ayodhya, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, न हि शक्या not possible.

40004248.author: Translation
40004248.content: Just as a sinner cannot enter the capital of Indra (heaven), it is impossible for me to enter Ayodhya without you.

40004249.author: पदार्थः
40004249.content: मम myself, एषः हि this alone, मनोरथः cherished desire, यत् that, वनवासे in the forest, क्षयम् completion, प्राप्ते gaining, अनेन by this, रथेनैव chariot alone, त्वाम् you, पुनः again, पुरीम् to the city (Ayodhya), वहेयम् shall take.

40004249.author: Translation
40004249.content: It is my cherished desire to take you after the completion of your exile, back to the city (Ayodhya) in this chariot alone.

40004250.author: पदार्थः
40004250.content: वने in the forest, त्वया with you, सहितस्य accompanied, चतुर्दश वर्षाणि fourteen years, क्षणभूतानि like a moment, यास्यन्ति will pass, अत: more than this, अन्यथा in any other way,  शतसङ्ख्यानि (will seem like) a hundred years.

40004250.author: Translation
40004250.content: If I accompany you into the forest, fourteen years will pass like a moment, otherwise it will seem like a hundred years.

40004251.author: पदार्थः
40004251.content: भृत्यवत्सल one who is affectionate towards the servants, भर्तृपुत्र master's son, पथि on the path, तिष्ठन्तम् standing, भक्तम् devotee, भृत्यम् servant, स्थित्याम् on duty, स्थितम् fixed, माम् me, त्वम् you, हातुम् to forsake न अर्हसि does not behove.

40004251.author: Translation
40004251.content: O Rama you are affectionate towards your servants. I abide in the path followed by you, my master's son. I am your devoted servant. It does not behove you to forsake me who is faithful.

40004252.author: पदार्थः
40004252.content: भृत्यानुकम्पी compassionate towards servants, रामः Rama, एवम् in this way, बहुविधम् in many ways, पुनः पुनः again and again, याचमानम् requesting, दीनम् miserable, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40004252.author: Translation
40004252.content: Repeatedly implored in various ways by the miserable Sumantra, Rama who is compassionate to his servants replied:

40004253.author: पदार्थः
40004253.content: भर्तृवत्सल one loyal to the master, ते your, मयि in me, परमाम् supreme, भक्तिम् devotion, जानामि I know, इतः from here, त्वम् you, यदर्थम् for the reason, पुरीम् to Ayodhya, प्रेषयामि I am sending, शृणु चापि please listen.

40004253.author: Translation
40004253.content: O Sumantra, listen I know your deep devotion to me (I also know) you are loyal to your master (Dasaratha). So I am sending you to the city (Ayodhya) from here.

40004254.author: पदार्थः
40004254.content: नगरीम् to the city of Ayodhya, गतम् gone, त्वाम् you, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, मे my, यवीयसी younger, जननी mother, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, रामः Rama, वनम् to the forest, गतः had gone, इति thus, प्रत्ययम् conviction, गच्छेत् will have.

40004254.author: Translation
40004254.content: When my younger mother Kaikeyi sees that you have returned to Ayodhya, she will believe that Rama has really gone to the forest.

40004255.author: पदार्थः
40004255.content: मयि when I, वनवासम् dwell in the forest, गते having gone, सा देवी that queen, परितुष्टा completely satisfied, धार्मिकम् righteous, राजानम् about king Dasaratha, 'मिथ्यावादी'ति   claimed to be a liar, नातिशङ्केत not have any doubt.

40004255.author: Translation
40004255.content: If queen Kaikeyi is fully satisfied that I have gone to dwell in the forest, she will no longer have any doubt and will believe that righteous king Dasaratha is not a liar.

40004256.author: पदार्थः
40004256.content: एषः this is, मे my, प्रथमः prime, कल्पः resolve, यत् that, मे my, यवीयसी younger, अम्बा mother, भरतारक्षितम् ruled by Bharata, स्फीतम् prosperous, पुत्रराज्यम् son's kingdom, अवाप्नुयात् will receive.

40004256.author: Translation
40004256.content: My prime resolve is that my younger mother should enjoy this prosperous and vast kingdom ruled by her son Bharata.

40004257.author: पदार्थः
40004257.content: त्वम् you, सरथः along with the chariot, मम my, राज्ञश्च king's, प्रियार्थम् for the sake of (my) pleasure, पुरीम् to the city (Ayodhya), व्रज return, यान् अर्थान् those messages intended for every one, सन्दिष्टः असि you have been advised, तान्तान् all such, तथा तथा in the same way, ब्रूयाः please tell.

40004257.author: Translation
40004257.content: Sumantra, return to the city with the chariot for my pleasure and also for the pleasure of the king and convey to each of the persons concerned the message exactly as instructed.

40004258.author: पदार्थः
40004258.content: अक्लीबः indefatigable, रामः Rama, सूतम् to the charioteer, इति thus, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having said, पुनः पुनः again and again, सान्त्वयित्वा after consoling, गुहम् to Guha, हेतुमत् reasonable, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

40004258.author: Translation
40004258.content: Having spoken to the charioteer and consoling him again and again, indefatigable Rama spoke to Guha words full of reasoning:

40004259.author: पदार्थः
40004259.content: गुह Guha, इदानीम् now, मे to me, सजने with people, वने in the forest, अयम् this, वासः abode, न योग्यः not suitable, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वासः dwelling, अवश्यम् is necessary, तद्गतः pertaining to that, विधिः prescribed acts, कर्तव्यः to be done.

40004259.author: Translation
40004259.content: Guha this forest where people live is not suitable for my stay. It is necessary that I live in a hermitage. So please do the needful.

40004260.author: पदार्थः
40004260.content: सः अहम् that I, तपस्विजनभूषणम् the adornment of ascetics, नियमम् prescribed austerities, गृहीत्वा accepting, पितुः father's, भूयः also, सीतायाः Sita's, लक्ष्मणस्य च also Lakshmana's, हितकामः seeking their good, जटाः कृत्वा having matted my locks of hair, गमिष्यामि shall go, न्यग्रोधक्षीरम् latex of banyan tree, आनय fetch.

40004260.author: Translation
40004260.content: Seeking the welfare of my father, Sita and Lakshmana I shall enter the forest with matted hair and practise the prescribed austerities which are the adornments of ascetics. Do fetch me the sap of a banyan tree.

40004261.author: पदार्थः
40004261.content: गुहः Guha, क्षिप्रम् quickly, राजपुत्राय for the prince (Rama), तत् that, क्षीरम् milk, उपाहरत् brought  , रामः Rama, तेन with that, लक्ष्मणस्य for Lakshmana, आत्मनश्चैव of his own, जटाः matted locks of hair, अकरोत् made.

40004261.author: Translation
40004261.content: Guha fetched the latex quickly and gave it to the prince (Rama) and with that Rama matted his own hair and  Lakshmana's.

40004262.author: पदार्थः
40004262.content: दीर्घबाहुः longarmed, नरव्याघ्रः tiger (best) among men, जटिलत्वम् their hair twisted and matted,  अधारयत् put on, तदा then, चीरवसनौ wearing the robes (of bark), जटामण्डलधारिणौ wearing crown of matted locks, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, ऋषिसमौ resembling sages, अशोभेताम् shone.

40004262.author: Translation
40004262.content: The longarmed Rama, the best of men, put on locks of matted hair. As the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana stood dressed in bark wearing crowns of matted hair, they resembled two resplendent ascetics.

40004263.author: पदार्थः
40004263.content: दीर्घबाहुः longarmed, नरव्याघ्रः tiger (best) among men, जटिलत्वम् their hair twisted and matted,  अधारयत् put on, तदा then, चीरवसनौ wearing the robes (of bark), जटामण्डलधारिणौ wearing crown of matted locks, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, ऋषिसमौ resembling sages, अशोभेताम् shone.

40004263.author: Translation
40004263.content: The longarmed Rama, the best of men, put on locks of matted hair. As the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana stood dressed in bark wearing crowns of matted hair, they resembled two resplendent ascetics.

40004264.author: पदार्थः
40004264.content: ततः thereafter, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, वैखानसम् relating to sages, मार्गम् the path, आस्थितः having resorted to, रामः Rama, व्रतम् religious vow, आदिष्टवान् having accepted, सखायम् his friend, गुहम् to Guha, अब्रवीत् said.

40004264.author: Translation
40004264.content: Having adopted the path of ascetics along with Lakshmana, Rama said to his friend Guha:

40004265.author: पदार्थः
40004265.content: गुह Guha, बले in the army, कोशे in the treasury, दुर्गे in the fort, तथा similarly, जनपदे in the provinces, अप्रमत्तः alert, भवेथाः you shall be, राज्यम् kingdom, दुरारक्षतमम् with great difficulty, मतं हि it is said.

40004265.author: Translation
40004265.content: O Guha you must be vigilant about your army, treasury, forts and provinces. A kingdom, it is (rightly) said, is protected with great difficulty.

40004266.author: पदार्थः
40004266.content: ततः then after, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः Delight of (also son of) the Iksvakus (Rama), तं गुहम् to that Guha, समनुज्ञाय after permitting him to leave, अव्यग्रः peacefully, सभार्यः with his consort, सहलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, तूर्णम् swiftly, जगाम went.

40004266.author: Translation
40004266.content: Rama, Delight of the Iksvakus, then permitted Guha to take leave. And departed quickly with his consort and Lakshmana in peace.

40004267.author: पदार्थः
40004267.content: सः इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः Rama, descendant of the Ikshvakus, नदीतीरे on the bank of the river, नावम् boat, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शीघ्रगाम् swiftly flowing, गङ्गाम् Ganga, तितीर्षुः intending to cross, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40004267.author: Translation
40004267.content: Seeing the boat on the river bank and intending to cross the swiftly flowing Ganga, Rama, descendant of the Iksvakus said to Lakshmana:

40004268.author: पदार्थः
40004268.content: नरव्याघ्रः (best) among men (Lakshmana), त्वम् you, स्थितम् standing, इमाम् this, नावम् boat, शनैः slowly, आरोह board, अन्वक्षम् along with the beam, मनस्विनीम् highminded, सीतां च Sita also, परिगृह्य holding her, आरोपय help her to get in.

40004268.author: Translation
40004268.content: O Lakshmana, the best of men the boat stands ready, get into it slowly (carefully), and then help the noble Sita board it by holding the beam (which balances the boat).

40004269.author: पदार्थः
40004269.content: आत्मवान् selfcontrolled, सः that Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा on hearing, सर्वम् all, अप्रतिकूलयन् without acting contrarily, पूर्वम् first, मैथिलीम् Sita, आरोप्य having helped her board, ततः thereafter, आरुरोह got in

40004269.author: Translation
40004269.content: Having heard his brother's command the selfcontrolled Lakshmana did as he was told.He first helped Sita get into the boat and  thereafter boarded it himself.

40004270.author: पदार्थः
40004270.content: अथ then after, तेजस्वी glorious, लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः Lakshmana's elder brother, स्वयम् himself, आरुरोह boarded, निषादाधिपतिः king of nishadas, गुहः Guha, ज्ञातीन् kinsmen, आचोदयत् unged (to row the boat).

40004270.author: Translation
40004270.content: With the boat boarded by the glorious Rama, Lakshmana's elder brother, Guha, king of the nishadas urged his kinsmen (to row the boat).

40004271.author: पदार्थः
40004271.content: महातेजाः राघवोऽपि even resplendent Rama, तां नावम् that boat, आरुह्य having boarded, ततः then, ब्रह्मवत् befitting brahmins, क्षत्रवच्चैव and also befitting kshatriyas, आत्मनः his own, हितम् welfare, जजाप muttered mantras.

40004271.author: Translation
40004271.content: Resplendent Rama boarded the boat and muttered for his own safety mantras befitting brahmins and kshatriyas.

40004272.author: पदार्थः
40004272.content: सीतया सह along with Sita, यथाशास्त्रम् as per the scriptures, आचम्य च sipping (the water of Ganga), प्रीतिसंहृष्टः with great pleasure, तां नदीम् that river, प्राणमत् paid obeisance, अमितप्रभः of unlimited radiance, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also.

40004272.author: Translation
40004272.content: Rama of undimmed radiance sipped the waters (of the Ganga) in accordance with the scriptures and with great pleasure and paid obeisance to the river with Sita and Lakshmana.

40004273.author: पदार्थः
40004273.content: रामस्तु as for Rama, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, सबलम् along with his army, तं गुहम् to that Guha, अनुज्ञाय permitting (to leave), नावम् boat, आस्थाय having seated, नाविकान् boatmen, चोदयामास directed to proceed.

40004273.author: Translation
40004273.content: Having permitted Sumantra and Guha with his army to leave, Rama seated on the boat urged the boatmen to proceed.

40004274.author: पदार्थः
40004274.content: ततः then, कर्णधारसमाहिता wellruddered by the helmsmen, सा नौः that boat, तैः by them, चोदिता rowed, शुभस्फ्यवेगाभिहता propelled by the speed of strong oars, शीघ्रम् swiftly, सलिलम् waters, अत्यगात् crossed.

40004274.author: Translation
40004274.content: The wellruddered boat rowed by the helmsmen and propelled by strong oars, swiftly crossed the waters of the river.

40004275.author: पदार्थः
40004275.content: अनिन्दिता blameless, वैदेही Sita, भागीरथ्याः river Bhagheerathi's, मध्यम् middle, समनुप्राप्य having reached, प्राञ्जलिः भूत्वा with folded palms, तां नदीम् to that river, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् uttered.

40004275.author: Translation
40004275.content: When the boat reached the midstream that unblemished Sita with palms folded invoked the river thus:

40004276.author: पदार्थः
40004276.content: गङ्गे O Ganga, धीमतः of the sagacious, महाराजस्य of the maharaja, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्रः son, अयम् Rama, त्वदभिरक्षितः protected by you, इमम् this, निदेशम् command, पालयित्वा having obeyed, भ्रात्रा सह with brother, मया चैव with me also, चतुर्दश fourteen, वर्षाणि years, समग्राणि full, कानने in the forest, उष्य having stayed, पुनः again, प्रत्यागमिष्यति will come back, सुभगे देवी O fortunate Devi, गङ्गे Ganga, ततः then, क्षेमेण safely, पुनः again, आगता reaching, प्रमुदिता highly delighted, सर्वकामसमृध्दिनी having fulfilled all my desires, त्वाम् you, यक्ष्ये worship.

40004276.author: Translation
40004276.content: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.

40004277.author: पदार्थः
40004277.content: गङ्गे O Ganga, धीमतः of the sagacious, महाराजस्य of the maharaja, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्रः son, अयम् Rama, त्वदभिरक्षितः protected by you, इमम् this, निदेशम् command, पालयित्वा having obeyed, भ्रात्रा सह with brother, मया चैव with me also, चतुर्दश fourteen, वर्षाणि years, समग्राणि full, कानने in the forest, उष्य having stayed, पुनः again, प्रत्यागमिष्यति will come back, सुभगे देवी O fortunate Devi, गङ्गे Ganga, ततः then, क्षेमेण safely, पुनः again, आगता reaching, प्रमुदिता highly delighted, सर्वकामसमृध्दिनी having fulfilled all my desires, त्वाम् you, यक्ष्ये worship.

40004277.author: Translation
40004277.content: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.

40004278.author: पदार्थः
40004278.content: गङ्गे O Ganga, धीमतः of the sagacious, महाराजस्य of the maharaja, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्रः son, अयम् Rama, त्वदभिरक्षितः protected by you, इमम् this, निदेशम् command, पालयित्वा having obeyed, भ्रात्रा सह with brother, मया चैव with me also, चतुर्दश fourteen, वर्षाणि years, समग्राणि full, कानने in the forest, उष्य having stayed, पुनः again, प्रत्यागमिष्यति will come back, सुभगे देवी O fortunate Devi, गङ्गे Ganga, ततः then, क्षेमेण safely, पुनः again, आगता reaching, प्रमुदिता highly delighted, सर्वकामसमृध्दिनी having fulfilled all my desires, त्वाम् you, यक्ष्ये worship.

40004278.author: Translation
40004278.content: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.

40004279.author: पदार्थः
40004279.content: देवि O Devi, त्रिपथगा one flowing in the three worlds, त्वम् you, ब्रह्मलोकम् the region of Brahma, the creator, समीक्षसे हि are seeing, अस्मिन् in this, लोके world, उदधिराजस्य king of the ocean, भार्या च are a spouse, संप्रदृश्यसे appear (to mortals).

40004279.author: Translation
40004279.content: O Devi, you are Tripathaga, flowing in three directions (worlds). You behold the region of Brahma and happen to be the spouse of the king of the ocean in this world (of mortals).

40004280.author: पदार्थः
40004280.content: देवि O Devi, शोभने O lovely one, सा that me, त्वाम् you, नमस्यामि pay homage, प्रशंसामि च adore, शिवेन safely, पुनः again, आगते on return, नरव्याघ्रे (best) among men, प्राप्तराज्ये having regained the kingdom, तव to you, प्रियचिकीर्षया to with the intention of pleasing, गवाम् of cows, शतसहस्राणि one hundred thousand, वस्त्राणि clothes, पेशलम् very delicious, अन्नं च food also, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, प्रदास्यामि will give.

40004280.author: Translation
40004280.content: O Devi O lovely Ganga I offer you my obeisance and my adorations. After the safe return of Rama, the tiger (best) among men, from the forest and after he regains the kingdom I shall give a hundred thousand cows, clothing and delicious food to brahmins as a mark of regard, which will please you.

40004281.author: पदार्थः
40004281.content: देवि O Devi, शोभने O lovely one, सा that me, त्वाम् you, नमस्यामि pay homage, प्रशंसामि च adore, शिवेन safely, पुनः again, आगते on return, नरव्याघ्रे (best) among men, प्राप्तराज्ये having regained the kingdom, तव to you, प्रियचिकीर्षया to with the intention of pleasing, गवाम् of cows, शतसहस्राणि one hundred thousand, वस्त्राणि clothes, पेशलम् very delicious, अन्नं च food also, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, प्रदास्यामि will give.

40004281.author: Translation
40004281.content: O Devi O lovely Ganga I offer you my obeisance and my adorations. After the safe return of Rama, the tiger (best) among men, from the forest and after he regains the kingdom I shall give a hundred thousand cows, clothing and delicious food to brahmins as a mark of regard, which will please you.

40004282.author: पदार्थः
40004282.content: देवि O Devi, पुनः again, पुरीम् Ayodhya, उपागता having reached, प्रयता purified by austerities, सुराघटसहस्रेण with a thousand pots of nectar, मांसभूतौदनेन च food in the form of meat, यक्ष्ये offer you and worship you.

40004282.author: Translation
40004282.content: O Devi after my return to Ayodhya  purified by my austerities, I shall worship you by offering a thousand pots of nectar and food in the form of meat.

40004283.author: पदार्थः
40004283.content: यानि all those, दैवतानि deities, त्वत्तीरवासीनि inhabiting your banks, सन्ति are found तानि all, सर्वाणि of them, तीर्थानि all sacred spots, आयतनानि च all temples, यक्ष्यामि I will worship.

40004283.author: Translation
40004283.content: I shall worship all those deities inhabiting your banks and all sacred spots and temples.

40004284.author: पदार्थः
40004284.content: अनघे O sacred one, अनघः blemishless, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, मया with me, भ्रात्रा च and also with brother, सङ्गतः together with, वनवासात् after the exile in the forest, पुनरेव again, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, प्रविशतु may enter.

40004284.author: Translation
40004284.content: O sacred one may the blemishless, mightyarmed Rama accompanied by me and his brother reenter Ayodhya after the exile.

40004285.author: पदार्थः
40004285.content: अनिन्दिता blameless, दक्षिणा auspicious, सा सीता that sita, तथा thus, सम्भाषमाणा addressing, क्षिप्रमेव quickly, दक्षिणम् southern, तीरम् side, अभ्युपागमत् reached.

40004285.author: Translation
40004285.content: While the unblemished, auspicious Sita was thus addressing (the river), the boat swiftly reached the south bank.

40004286.author: पदार्थः
40004286.content: नरर्षभः the best of men, परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, तीरम् bank, समनुप्राप्य having reached, नावम् the boat, हित्वा leaving, भ्रात्रा सह with his brother, वैदेह्या च and Sita, प्रातिष्ठत proceeded forward.

40004286.author: Translation
40004286.content: Rama, the best of men and tormentor of enemies, after  reaching  the other side of the river, left the boat and proceeded with Sita and his brother.

40004287.author: पदार्थः
40004287.content: अथ then, महाबाहुः one with long arms, सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनम् to Lakshmana, enhancer of the joy of Sumitra, अब्रवीत् said, सजने in populated areas, विजनेऽपि वा or in solitary places, संरक्षणार्थाय for protection, भव be ready.

40004287.author: Translation
40004287.content: The longarmed Rama then said to Lakshmana,  enhancer of the joy of Sumitra: Whether in populated areas  or in solitary places, excercise alacrity in the matter of protection.

40004288.author: पदार्थः
40004288.content: अदृष्टे unseen, विजने devoid of people, वने in the forest, अवश्यम् certainly, रक्षणम्  protection, कार्यम् is to be rendered, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, अग्रतः in front, गच्छ go, सीता Sita, त्वाम् you, अनुगच्छतु may follow.

40004288.author: Translation
40004288.content: In this desolate forest which we had never seen before we must certainly be concerned about our protection. O Lakshmana , let Sita follow you

40004289.author: पदार्थः
40004289.content: अहम् I, त्वां च you also, सीतां च also Sita ,पालयन् protecting, पृष्ठतः behind, गमिष्यामि I will keep walking, पुरुषर्षभ best of men, इह here, न: for us, अन्योन्यस्य mutually, रक्षा protection, कर्तव्या fit to be done.

40004289.author: Translation
40004289.content: O best of men, I will follow you and Sita and keep watch. We must ensure  mutual protection.

40004290.author: पदार्थः
40004290.content: अतिक्रान्ता a thing of the past, काचन क्रिया any task, सुकरा difficult, न हि तावत् not possible, अद्य now, वैदेही Sita, वनवासस्य life in the forest, दुःखम् difficulties, वेत्स्यति will come to know.

40004290.author: Translation
40004290.content: We have not yet confronted any hardship. From now on Sita will come to know the difficulties of forest life.

40004291.author: पदार्थः
40004291.content: प्रणष्टजनसम्बाधम् devoid of concourse of people, क्षेत्रारामविवर्जितम् devoid of farms and gardens, विषमम् च uneven and inaccessible, प्रपातं च with deep ditches, वनम् forest, अद्य now, प्रवेक्ष्यति will enter.

40004291.author: Translation
40004291.content: Now she will enter the forest which is devoid of concourse of people, farms and pleasure groves and which is uneven and inaccessible and full of deep ditches.

40004292.author: पदार्थः
40004292.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामस्य at Rama's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अग्रतः ahead, प्रतस्थे went, सीतायाः Sita's, अनन्तरम् behind, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghus, राघवः Rama.

40004292.author: Translation
40004292.content: Having heard the words of Rama, Lakshmana went ahead and Rama, delight of the Raghus, walked behind Sita.

40004293.author: पदार्थः
40004293.content: तपस्वी the miserable, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, आशु swiftly, गङ्गापरपारम् other side of Ganga, गतम् reached, रामम् of Rama, प्रततम् continuously, निरीक्ष्य having gazed, अध्वप्रकर्षात् due to long distance, विनिवृत्तदृष्टिः turning away his sight, व्यथितः distressed, बाष्पम् मुमोच shed tears.

40004293.author: Translation
40004293.content: The wretched Sumantra kept gazing at Rama who swiftly reached the other side of the Ganga and only when he could not see him because of long distance, he turned away his gaze and, overcome with grief, shed tears.

40004294.author: पदार्थः
40004294.content: महात्मा highsouled, वरदः bestower of boons, लोकपालप्रतिप्रभाववान् equal in splendour to the Protector of the world, सः he (such Rama), महानदीम् mighty river, तीर्त्वा having crossed, ततः then, क्रमेण gradually, समृद्धान् highly prosperous, मुदितान् with happy people, वत्सा (country known as) Vatsa, उपागमत् reached.

40004294.author: Translation
40004294.content: Having crossed that mighty river, the highsouled Rama, bestower of boons and equal in splendour, to the Protector of the world reached Vatsa by and by, a highly prosperous country inhabited by happy people.

40004295.author: पदार्थः
40004295.content: बुभुक्षितौ famished, तौ they, तत्र there, वराहम् a boar, ऋश्यम् a whitefooted male antelope, पृषतम् spotted deer, महारुरुम् a great deer with black stripes, चतुरः four, मृगान् animals, हत्वा killed, मेध्यम् pure meat, त्वरितम् quickly, आदाय partaking as food, काले in the evening, वासाय for rest, वनस्पतिम् under a tree, ययतुः reached.

40004295.author: Translation
40004295.content: Famished, they (Rama and Lakshmana) killed a boar, a rishya (whitefooted male antelope), a spotted deer and a great deer with black stripes. They partook the meat and reached a tree by evening where they rested for the night. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्विपञ्चाश स्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of  the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
